title: Equipment-Age Share Table for Transfers of Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection
content:
**Rule.** On a home-sale transfer of a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, an equipment-age share applies by multiplication to the open benefit carried to the buyer. It is set by the whole calendar months from the installed date of the Harbison installation named on the contract — the installation record under Replacement System Installations — or from the coverage start where it names none, to the closing date on the transfer request.

| Whole calendar months from the installed date (or coverage start) to the closing date | Equipment-age share |
|---|---|
| more than 120 months | 0.80 |
| more than 84 and up to 120 months | 0.90 |
| 84 months or fewer | 1 |

**Both sides of each threshold.**

| Months | Share |
|---|---|
| 84 | 1 |
| 85 | 0.90 |
| 120 | 0.90 |
| 121 | 0.80 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Installed date 15 July 2017, closing date 20 August 2026: 109 whole months, share 0.90. An open benefit of $8000.00 multiplied by 0.90 is $7200.00.
